notes.title: 1.05 hotfix
notes.content:
- fixed some localization shows '로드중 ...' instead of message.
- dog added.

notes.title: 1.04 Hotfix + a little update
notes.content:
bug fix

- trying to fix black screen (currently screen resolution changes
from 1920 x 1080 down to 1024 x 768 automatically when it's black screen).

regular patch

- Achievement added.
- Kids event added.
- Polar bear added.
- Ice cream truck, dogs added (has no interaction yet).
- New planets: Dublin, Bradford, Sutherland.
- New event in Butterloo.

notes.title: 1.02 Patch
notes.content:
Patch is mainly about bug fix and new system, functions this time.

- Now settings have 'full screen' in the list.
- Bruno, Jose have more trade goods.
- New NPC Barrien
- New Planets: Caen, Plymouth, Bordeaux, Cornwall
- Incinerator added (currently has no effect other than removing garbages).
- Crab hostage now goes back to the butter planets when players reach Caen castle.
- Can change fuel with shortcut.
- Added cutscene.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.00
notes.content:
(Gamepad)
- Cancel key is now B, instead of X (Xbox)
Xbox 패드 기준으로 취소 키는 B키에서 X키로 옮겼습니다.

- Unique Interaction (such as sailing) is now displayed as 'Y' key (Xbox) instead of LB
특수 상호작용 (항해, 거래) 는 이제 LB 키 대신 Y키로 제대로 표시됩니다.

- Inventory now works with start key
이제 시작 버튼으로도 인벤토리를 열 수 있습니다.

- Wrong text help is now fixed
잘못된 도움말이 수정됐습니다.

- Right stick now works
패드 오른쪽 스틱이 작동합니다.

(General)
- Asteroids are now disappearing once they hit onto the planet
운석류는 이제 행성에 닿으면 사라집니다.
